output.review_comment: The weekend holiday observation logic (Saturday→Friday, Sunday→Monday) appears to be reverse-engineered from the specific `test_july_fourth_week_2026` test case rather than derived from documented requirements. This could indicate overfitting to particular test inputs. Additionally, the PR lacks confirmation that the test suite actually passes after these changes, which is the core requirement. Please: (1) Run the full test suite and confirm all tests pass, (2) Verify the weekend holiday logic is consistent across multiple test cases, not just the one mentioned, and (3) Clarify whether these rule changes are part of the agreed-upon spec or inferred solely from test analysis.
